scope: Monetary income inventory and fiscal-aligned candidate TTM, no EPS subtraction, price, returns, labels, HTTP or model fitting.
conditions: Before computing bind exact repaired RecorderID/archive/manifest; parent plan alone is not source byte identity.
Annual/currentYTD/priorYTD must use identical issuer,taxonomy,tag,currency and frozen fiscal alignment.
Retain all component accession/start/end/filed/available identities; latesteligible components can mix accounting/restatement bases, so mark compatibility unresolved rather than certify.
Separate us-gaap NetIncomeLoss and IFRS ProfitLoss method identities; never treat names as automatically identical earnings attributable to common equity.
Directannual and constructedTTM methods, period age and negative income remain explicit.
Old filing amendments cannot rewind holdings report date; no unknown earnings zero fill or coverage renormalization.
Candidate amounts may be emitted even with original-document/accounting proof unresolved, but cannot become final qualified EP inputs.
